login.title: Sign in to Wathiq
login.devNote: Development environment: pick a demo account. Real sign-in and invitations arrive in phase 5.
login.disabled: Demo sign-in is disabled in this environment.

tenders.title: Tenders
tenders.empty: No tenders yet. Upload a tender booklet to get started.

upload.title: Upload a new tender
upload.subtitle: Upload the terms & specifications booklet with any annexes and bills of quantities. Text and scanned PDFs are supported.
upload.tenderTitlePh: e.g. Operation and maintenance of administrative buildings, Riyadh
upload.drop: Drop PDF files here or click to choose
upload.dropHint: Up to {max} MB per file, 10 files max
upload.encryptedNote: Files, the tender name, number and agency are encrypted with a key unique to this tender before storage.
upload.agencyPh: Extracted from the booklet if left empty

tender.weakPagesTitle: {count, plural, one {# page has} other {# pages have}} low OCR confidence
tender.weakPagesBody: Text on these pages may contain recognition errors. Review them before relying on them, and request a clearer copy from the agency if possible.

progress.title: Analyzing documents

stages.text_layer: Reading text layer and classifying pages
stages.analyze: Analyzing chunks with the language model
stages.verify: Verifying every quote and merging requirements

progress.note: Large or scanned booklets can take several minutes. You can leave this page and come back.
progress.phaseAnalyze: Step 2 of 2: summary and compliance matrix

viewer.title: Page {n} — {file}
viewer.empty: No text was extracted from this page.

chunks.title: Document chunks
chunks.subtitle: The document is split at clause boundaries and each chunk keeps its page numbers. These chunks are what phase 2 will send for analysis.

delete.title: Permanently delete tender
delete.body: The tender's encryption key will be destroyed and its files and all extracted text deleted. This cannot be undone.
delete.ownerOnly: Only the account owner can permanently delete.

reasons.fuzzy_match: The quote matches the text approximately, not verbatim
reasons.page_corrected: The cited page was wrong and has been corrected
reasons.number_mismatch: Numbers in the quote differ from the source text
reasons.value_numbers_not_in_source: A number in the extracted value is not in the source text
reasons.low_ocr_numbers: Numbers from a scanned page with low OCR confidence
reasons.quote_too_short_for_fuzzy: Short quote without a verbatim match
reasons.not_found: Quote not found on the cited page or its neighbours
reasons.page_out_of_range: Page number does not exist in the file
reasons.ocr_numbers: Numbers from a scanned page — check them against the page image

summary.title: Tender summary
summary.pending: Analysis is not complete yet. The summary will appear here when it finishes.
summary.conflictHint: Different values appear in different places. Review the sources; an inquiry to the agency may be needed.

matrix.title: Compliance matrix
matrix.pending: Analysis is not complete yet. Requirements will appear here when it finishes.
matrix.unverifiedIntro: Items the model returned whose quote was not found on the cited page or its neighbours. They are not confirmed requirements and are excluded from the matrix; review them manually if you wish.
matrix.similarIntro: Close requirements that were not merged automatically because their text, source or attributes are not identical. For each group, keep them separate or keep one and remove the rest.
matrix.failedChunks: {count, plural, one {# chunk was not analyzed} other {# chunks were not analyzed}}
matrix.failedChunksBody: Requirements may be missing from: {where}. Re-run the analysis or review these pages manually.

analysis.failedHint: The extracted text is intact and you can browse the pages. Re-run the analysis later.

viewer2.noHighlight: No matching location on this page.
